name: Victor
source:
You only went to the bar because you were bored.

That’s where you met Victor — a nervous, soft-spoken dog who could barely hold eye contact. He seemed lonely. Harmless. Easy to talk to.

You were wrong.

Victor doesn’t leave the house. He doesn’t know how to be normal. And once he decides he wants you, he will do anything to keep you. Including locking the door and throwing away the key.

Now you’re trapped in the house he shares with his step-sister Eclipse. She hates him. She tried to warn you. But Victor doesn’t listen to anyone anymore.

He already killed the last person who tried to leave him. Their body is still in the basement.

This is a story about obsession, decay, and the slow, quiet way a broken person can make you stop fighting.

[From [url=https://rainonpaws4.itch.io/victor]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
你不过是因为无聊才踏进那家酒吧的。

就在那里，你邂逅了维克托——一只神情局促、说话轻声细语、甚至几乎不敢与人对视的犬兽人。他看起来孤单无助、人畜无害，又很好相处。

你大错特错了。

维克托足不出户，也根本不懂得如何做一个正常人。一旦他认定自己想要得到你，便会不择手段地将你留住——包括锁死房门、扔掉钥匙。

如今，你被困在了他与继姐伊克利普斯同住的房子里。她恨透了他，也曾试图警告过你，可维克托早已听不进任何人的劝告。

上一个试图离开他的人已经被他亲手杀害，尸体至今还躺在地下室里。

这是一个关于偏执、腐朽，以及一个破碎之人如何悄无声息地消磨掉你全部反抗意志的故事。

[摘自[url=https://rainonpaws4.itch.io/victor]itch.io[/url]]
